catalog_sources.note: The MSP catalogue and the Ek-1e detail symbols are compiled from the Ministry's published annexes, not from the UIP source above. Their digests are repeated here so that this one file answers 'what is in the package, and from where'. Each compiler records the digests of its own inputs in the file it writes; the MSP compiler additionally refuses to write when one of them disagrees.
